member_conditions: Detect is restricted to psis or psionic activity; Scanning Sense means Para-Radar.
Secret rolls; Precognition and Psychometry failures by more than 5 require false information.

entries.name: Psychic Healing
member_conditions: Detect targets disease or poison; Resistant targets noxious physical effects.

entries.name: Psychokinesis
member_conditions: DR requires Force Field; Enhanced Move applies to Air or Water.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries.supported_subset: Representative Telepathic Mind Reading only; this does not implement the power Talent or every member.
member_conditions: Affliction and Innate Attack require Malediction and only fatigue, stunning, incapacitation, temporary mental disadvantages or DX/IQ/Will penalties.
Normally limited to living sentient subjects.

entries.name: Area boundary variants
entries.supported_subset: Paid square and axial-hex circles, explicit affected subsets, four-yard default height, and Create Fire integration.

entries.name: Blocking spells
entries.supported_subset: Typed instant defense, one-per-turn limit, critical-hit exclusion, active-spell penalty, and unreduced cost contract for concrete Blocking spells.

entries.name: Ceremonial Magic
entries.supported_subset: Approved participant roles and limits, opposition cap, energy bonus steps, tenfold time, automatic-failure ceiling, atomic FP/HP payments, retries, and shared-location validation.

entries.name: Clerical Magic
entries.supported_subset: Explicit opt-in tradition boundary; unselected clerical casting fails closed before spell execution.

entries.name: Information spells
entries.supported_subset: Stable caster, spell, subject, and day identity enforcing the per-day attempt boundary without exposing results.

entries.name: Magic items and enchantment activation
entries.supported_subset: Concrete inventory binding, holder and disabled checks, Magery restriction, mana-sensitive Power, and mana-sensitive energy reduction through SpellService.

entries.name: Melee spells
entries.supported_subset: Typed held hand-or-staff charge boundary for concrete Melee spells; it cannot be substituted with a missile attack.

entries.name: Ritual Magic
entries.supported_subset: Explicit opt-in tradition boundary; unselected ritual-magic casting fails closed before spell execution.

entries.name: Create Fire
entries.supported_subset: Execution v2: fixed ground area, full-turn exposure and transient crossings.

entries.name: Daze

entries.name: Fireball
entries.supported_subset: Execution v2: held missile, expansion, Wait, injury and supported body criticals; remaining physical criticals are #173.
